text_block_list.text: One day, while taking a walk along the riverbank—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyoeeeh~! I-I'm... I'm so sorrrry~~!!
Hearing a scream, I rushed over to find... TM Opera O and Meisho Doto surrounded by some rough-looking horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Oi! What d'ya think you're doing, merrily singing away at our hangout spot?! Wanna go take a dip in that river over there?! Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-Hiiieee~~...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! As you can plain see!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: While rehearsing a brand-new opera with Doto, an enthusiastic crowd of passionate fans flocked around us!
I have no idea how that's "plain to see"... but at this rate, a fight is bound to break out. Just as I try to step in and mediate—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, but you arrived at such an opportune moment! We were just entering the scene where I take the princess's hand and do battle with the pirates!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Join our rehearsal as well, all of you! Flaunt your reckless bravado across the four seas, and play the role of vulgar, fearless pirates to perfection!

text_block_list.name: Villainous Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: What the hell kind of nonsense are you spouting?! Are you making fun of us?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come, my Princess! Keep pace closely with me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees, hyah~!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah?! You think you can run away, punk?! Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Princess! Whatever you do, do not let go of my hand!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyoeeeeeh...!
And then... with dance-like footwork, the two continuously dodged the delinquents trying to grab them!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: D-Damn it...! This girl is too nimble...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Glitt~ering white blades♪
We sli~p right through them all~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Shall we cut our way thr~ough, or perish right here...♪
Now tested is the worth~ of a true he~ro...♪

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Wh... What?! Why the hell did you suddenly start singing?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come, now it is your part!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Our part, you say?
Heh! What the heck~ are you say~ing~♪

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...?! Wh-What is this~♪
My body's on its own... hu~mming along to the song♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is no nee~d for shame♪
The glittering stage of the Overlord...
Unleash that uncontainable passion... set it free~♪

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I... I won't accept such a thing~♪
Because♪ We hold tight to our delinquent pride~...♪

text_block_list.name: Villainous Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Chase them down♪ Capture them tight♪
All that we desire is♪

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Beat 'em black♪ And beat 'em blue♪
Knock 'em flat to~ the~ gro~und~♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~ looming clo~ser is danger~♪
A hopeless situation, is it all over alreaaadhyyy~~...♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet I will never allow it♪ I shall protect to the end♪
My most beloved~ one~♪

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: La la la~...♪

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Damn it!
You better remember this!!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
We'll ne~ver forge~t this humiliation♪
We shall su~rely have our revenge~...♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Do come watch the actual show as well! I shall prepare special seats for you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-Amazing, hyuu~... To act completely unchanged even in front of delinquents...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ahh~... what incredible spirit~♪
Such unshakeable~ fortitude~♪
...At any rate, without needing any help from me, TM Opera O's remarkable performance? brought the situation completely under control.
